notes: «وأنا معه» makes Nafi' a first-person witness of the walk to Rafi' («فحدثه رافع»): a first-person narrative with implicit transmission, so the ruling is open (rule 11)
«بعض عمومته» names no uncle: unnamed link before the Prophet
«كان ابن عمر يأخذ كراء الأرض» is the scene; Ibn Umar is not a link
